_note: Map features. Resource nodes are placed in a ring around the hearth (min_distance/max_distance override the ring); dens far out in the wilds. heroes_only nodes are out in hero territory: townsfolk never gather them, heroes pick them up and sell them to the settlement once the buyer building stands, for price shells each, while it holds fewer than buy_until. wild nodes sit by the dens: heroes fetch them the same way, and townsfolk only go when no monster is within wild_safe_radius (so once heroes have cleared the den nearby). age = the node only counts once the town reaches that age. A den's later = from that round on, it spawns something else (by round, never by age). A den with camp = true is never placed at the start: it is the war camp raiders held back by catch-up make (see _camp_note in balance.json).
